description: Retrieve farm management tasks, newest due date first by default (tasks without a due date last). Filters: status (Pending | In Progress | Completed, case-insensitive, string or array; omit for all), excludeCompleted, dueFrom/dueTo (inclusive YYYY-MM-DD in the farm timezone, default America/New_York), assignedTo, titleContains. Paginate by passing the returned nextCursor as cursor with the same filters. Requires farmId and apiKey authorization.

assignedTo.description: Filter by assigned user ID, name, or email (case-insensitive exact match)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page (pass nextCursor)

dueFrom.description: Filter tasks due on or after YYYY-MM-DD (farm timezone, default America/New_York)

dueTo.description: Filter tasks due on or before YYYY-MM-DD (farm timezone, default America/New_York)

sort.description: Sort order by due date (default: dueDate_desc)

status.description: Task status filter: Pending, In Progress, Completed (string or array). Case-insensitive. Omit for all statuses.

name: get_tasks
